transcript: Last night I saw Stereophonic at Playwrights Horizons and it was amazing it's about a band in the 70s working on an album to follow up on their recent chart topper the entire play takes place in the recording studio and clocking in at a little over three hours long you can totally understand how the characters would go crazy being cooped up together working these long days, and they do this play examines how the nature of creation can both deepen and destroy relationships and the complexities of collaborating with pressures and egos at play Rumors by Fleetwood Mac comes to mind an album whose recording process is notoriously documented as having been extremely dramatic and full of drug use Stereophonic features a ton of original music by Will Butler of Arcade Fire which the actors do play live and they're amazing the whole setup of the studio and the recording process looks super realistic and the sound design is really really incredible Stereophonic is running through November 26th so see it while you can. With that, another program for my collection.
